title: HB346 (135th Legislature (2023-2024)): Create offense - manufacture, purchase, or sale of an auto sear

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Ohio) (gun-policy Stage 5, Ohio); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Ohio text (As Introduced (00_IN), ; official copy, https://search-prod.lis.state.oh.us/api/v2/general_assembly_135/legislation/hb346/00_IN/pdf/ (Open States text id 90134228))
provenance.note: As introduced. Exemptions in 2923.191(B) for officers, military, licensed dealers, carriers and permit holders not quoted.

operative_text:
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.11(K)(6)): Any part or combination of parts that is intended by the owner for use in converting any firearm or other device into a dangerous ordnance, including an auto sear.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.11(S)): "Auto sear" means any part or combination of parts that is designed to convert a weapon to automatically discharge more than one round without manual reloading, by a single function of the trigger.
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.191(A)): No person shall knowingly manufacture, purchase, sell, transfer, distribute, or import an auto sear.
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.191(C)): Whoever violates division (A) of this section is guilty of unlawful manufacture, purchase, or sale of an auto sear, a felony of the fifth degree.
